description: This file defines a Java class `RenderableFtlMacroCall` which models a call to an FTL macro, including its name and parameters; it provides builder methods for creating instances with various parameter types.

classes.name: RenderableFtlMacroCall
classes.description: Immutable class representing an FTL macro call with a name and parameters, implementing the RenderableFtl interface.

classes.name: RenderableFtlMacroCallBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing instances of RenderableFtlMacroCall with flexible parameter setting.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor object that implements RenderableFtlVisitor to perform operations on this macro call.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the macro.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the map of parameters associated with this macro call.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for constructing a RenderableFtlMacroCall.

methods.name: name (Builder method)
methods.description: Sets the macro name in the builder.

methods.name: stringParameter
methods.description: Adds a string parameter to the macro call via the builder.

methods.name: intParameter
methods.description: Adds an integer parameter to the macro call via the builder.

methods.name: booleanParameter
methods.description: Adds a boolean parameter to the macro call via the builder.

methods.name: mapParameter
methods.description: Adds a map parameter to the macro call via the builder.

methods.name: objectParameter
methods.description: Adds an object parameter to the macro call via the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the RenderableFtlMacroCall object with the accumulated parameters.
